description: This file defines an interface IStreamQueueMapper responsible for mapping streams to queues in Orleans streaming subsystem, along with methods to retrieve all queues and the queue for a specific stream.

classes.name: IStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Interface for mapping streams to queues, ensuring thread safety and providing methods to retrieve queues.

methods.name: GetQueueForStream
methods.description: Retrieves the specific queue responsible for the given stream identifier.
